C_targets: each (stim, rec) pair of a counted functional_connectivity entry with neural_readout true and readout presence/sign/relative_size/latency_rank, stim an H1-H3 target MAPPED and rec a D: cell MAPPED
E_targets: counted afferent_tuning entry, Drosophila melanogaster, target H1-H3 MAPPED, joint coxa or trochanter, readout tuning_curve / threshold_angle / rate_vs_angle

annotation_query.annotation_identity: a table annotation that names a target is M-C (names alone) unless a checked source states the method that produced it, then graded as P2

banc_link.carries_over: the group has a cell_type, reaches exactly one male CNS type and every ID resolves to a typed body
banc_link.crosswalk: BANC joins the crosswalks only if the single annotation entry is counted (primary, second read agrees) and >= 1 hit group carries over
banc_link.groups: BANC hit rows grouped by cell_type
banc_link.ids: malecns_match parsed as comma-separated integer body IDs (rf_hair_plate_banc_v2.id_list), resolved to male CNS type through annotations bodyId
banc_link.level: none if no row of the group has an ID; group if any ID is shared by >= 2 rows of the group; neuron otherwise
banc_link.translation: BANC-sourced identity entries: BANC types replaced by their carried-over male CNS types, all or nothing; otherwise prefixed BANC: so that names alone never match

annotation_query.output: docs/evidence/hair-plate-review-v1/annotation_query.json (written once, exclusive create; evaluate re-runs the query and requires byte-identical output)
annotation_query.text_columns: every string-typed column (string, object or dictionary) of each table
annotation_query.typed: rows whose type column (BANC cell_type, male CNS type) equals SNpp45 exactly

consequence_declared_in_advance: TARGETS_AVAILABLE: design a held-out CNS validation of the hair-plate reflex pathway (live engine v1 first). ENCODER_VALIDATION_AVAILABLE: design a preregistered check of the Step B encoder against the measured tuning. MAPPING_ONLY: identity settled, nothing to validate yet. INSUFFICIENT: the conclusion write-up becomes the natural next step unless the user chooses own cross-dataset matching. No engine or encoder change in any case.
counting: an entry counts only if primary and its separate strict second read was done and agrees (P1/P2 rule)

expectations.X1: H1 SOURCE_ONLY with counted M-A/M-B sources exactly {FANC}, and verdict UNRESOLVED
expectations.X2: >= 1 hit BANC group carries over and every hit group with an ID is group-level
expectations.X3: >= 1 counted Drosophila afferent_tuning entry with a quantitative readout, and zero E-targets

grades: A/B/C per charter; grade C if and only if the species is not Drosophila melanogaster; grade C recorded, never counted
interpretation_limits: Public literature plus two annotation tables already in the repository; annotations are their authors inferences.
BANC malecns_match was group-level for SNpp45 in RF V2: at best type-level identity.
AI reviewer using web tools; declared queries, full log and separate strict second read as safeguards.
A mapping is an identity claim; afferent tuning is a sensory property; behaviour is reported only.
No engine or encoder change; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).

labels.INCONCLUSIVE: invalid entries, duplicate ids, unchecked entries, incomplete log, not exactly one annotation entry, or annotation entry not matching the output
labels.MAPPING_ONLY: any of H1-H3 MAPPED but neither of the above

Step A (HAIR_PLATE_IDENTITY_RESULTS.md): SNpp45 shows the CxHP8 output pattern in all six legs (our inference).

P2 entry PR26-fc (Pratt et al. 2026): CxHP8 axon calcium imaging during passive movement; reconstruction in FANC because hair-plate axons could not be identified in MANC; no recording of downstream neurons. This informed X1 and X3.
snowball: one level: references of included primary sources; citing papers of Pratt et al. 2026 via the Europe PMC citations service

snpp45_verdict.CONTRADICTED: H1 MAPPED without SNpp45 in its types, or a counted M-A/M-B H4 entry that carries over places SNpp45 as anything other than CxHP8 or an unspecified hair plate (takes precedence)
snpp45_verdict.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (incl. H1 MAPPED to a set containing SNpp45 and other types)

sources: public pages read-only; Europe PMC REST preferred for full text; bioRxiv/arXiv HTML; no bot-check, captcha, login or rate-limit bypass; no downloads without the user OK; no accounts or tokens; no personal data in queries
stop_rule: per question: declared queries + snowball, or 25 included sources, whichever first
